summary: Visible change: composer text now belongs to its chat. Switching chats shows that chat's unsent text instead of carrying the text over, and the text survives a remount of the input.
howTo: Nothing to configure. Tests or flows that expect the composer text to move into another chat after a session switch must switch back (or set the text again with useChatComposer().setDraft). Pills are kept with their ids; attachments are not part of a draft. Drafts live as long as the AiChatProvider instance: remount the provider with a key per verified identity so another user never sees them. Own session stores can use the ComposerDraft shape ({ text, mentions? }). See references/composer-starters-drafts.md#drafts.
